name: Waypoint interview field
prompt: High-fidelity desktop About-page composition probe for Alex Metelli’s editorial engineering portfolio. A compact site header leads into a split field: a narrow identity rail on the left with the real tall portrait, caption, and five-line capability index; a broad reading field on the right with About / Field Notes, the headline ‘Engineering work built around correctness, clarity, and delivery.’, a short factual lead, and a vertical blue waypoint line connecting What I work on, How I work, and What I’m looking for. The page closes with Correctness, Clarity, Delivery and restrained contact actions. Warm paper, deep navy ink, Georgia-like serif display, restrained evidence blue, sans body, square geometry, hairline rules, no gradients, shadows, cards, dashboard chrome, or invented claims.
